runs.text: 1. How do you decide which type of method to use?
The method type depends on the problem requirement.
Use a method with parameters when input must be provided by the caller.
Use a method with a return value when the result must be sent back to the caller.
Use a method with both parameters and a return value when it needs input and must send back a result.
Use a method with neither when the method performs the complete task internally.
A calling method is the method that calls another method.

runs.text: 23. How does separation of concerns apply at the class level?
Separation of concerns means placing related operations inside separate classes.
This keeps related functionality together and makes maintenance easier.
